approval_ref: The active user goal directs continued construction of an advanced-model Reference feature while retaining every existing analysis path.
notes: Add native strict JSON Schema as an explicit custom-profile capability; keep JSON object as the default.
Apply the capability only to QA V2 answers and QA V3 evidence decisions; do not change extraction, page vision, legacy questions or verification payloads.
Validate and translate only the known compatible Reference schema subset before dispatch; fail locally instead of guessing provider support.
Freeze the choice in durable call identity and Reference evaluation profiles, normalizing old profiles to their historical json_object behavior.
Do not probe a provider, call a model, automatically fall back or retry.

All 111 focused application and display tests passed by composite evidence, together with 24 localization tests. The focused set includes a two-mode MockTransport regression proving that json_object and json_schema receive distinct durable call identities and that the strict-mode replay makes no third request.

Composite full validation covers all 1,504 collected Python tests: every previously collected product test passed, the only first-pass failure was one historical task context budget, all 23 governance/devtool tests passed after changing only DEV-142 context metadata, and the newly added call-identity regression passed separately. Specification sync reports 148 requirements and 21 schemas; 11 deployment tests, change validation and the 617-file bundle manifest passed.

The local service restarted without a model call and preserved DeepSeek V4 Flash text-only configuration with structured_output_mode=json_object, zero active runs, zero active verification jobs and zero unresolved calls.
title: Add opt-in native structured output for Reference QA
objective: Let an explicitly configured custom OpenAI-compatible Reference route use a locally verified native strict JSON Schema request without changing or deleting existing model paths.
